notes.title: UPDATE 1.2 FINALLY HERE!
notes.notes:
This update brings the following new features:
[list]
[*] Custom challenge with Steam Leaderboards
[*] Hats system linked to a Level system
[*] Custom Hat creation
[/list]

[h1]Custom Challenges[/h1]
There is a new editor that allows you to create challenges and share them throught the Steam Workshop.
Every challenge you create will have its own dedicated worldwide leaderboard so that you can compete with everyone else. You can access any custom challenge you are subscribed to throgh a new eskimo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442965/57feb2fe9e6807c7802d4a5da980a334bd0b8fd6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hats[/h1]
You can now equip hats into your characters, these hats can be unlocked by playing the [i]free for all[/i] and [i]team vs[/i] game modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442965/1b3409fd1e01e2537af1b6a46044f065f37365be.png[/img]

Alongside these new features, some bug fixes are also introduced:
[list]
[*] Iglu hitbox reworked
[*] Eskimos can now be stunned with a burp
[*] Improved movement controls (hopefully the game is easier)
[*] Corrected players being drawn underneath iglus when falling
[*] Corrected food overlaping when stacked
[*] Corrected collision against enemies in tutorial and challenges
[*] Players will no longer get stuck when enemies fall over in the tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
The new update is here!
This update includes a new 1 player mode, the possibility to use custom food in the game and a lot of quality of life improvements. 

[h1]One player mode[/h1]
This game mode will consist on a variety of challenges in three different categories. Each challenge will have its own Steam Leaderboard, which will allow you to compete for the highest score.
The three different categories of the challenges are:
[olist]
[*]Elimination: You will have to defeat a number of enemies the faster you can.
[*]Speed: Going from point A to point B in the fastest time possible.
[*]Balance: Stay on ice the longer you can while obstacles appear around you.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442965/0a81b97cb67bf233ab5d0e8592e9b9e5aa76e2af.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Food[/h1]
Similarly to how custom characters can be used in the game, you will soon be able to use any ".png" image as food. You will be able to share them through the Steam Workshop so that anyone can use and enjoy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442965/bb596dc4560710f7b33c9a6fbca5466439c40ad7.png[/img]

[h1]In-game UI[/h1]
An new option is available to add in-game UI, this UI consists of an indicator of the wins, the food, and lifes each player has. If this option is on the name and the creator of custom levels will apear at the begining of each round.

[h1]Bugs and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Solved some bugs causing unexpected behaviour when two players would collide.
[*]Improved lists in the mods section.
[*]All menus are now more dynamic.
[*]General improvements in the character creation process.
[/list]

notes.title: INCOMING UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
A new update for the game is in the making.
This update will include a new 1 player mode, the possibility to use custom food in the game and a lot of quality of life improvements. 

[h3]One player mode[/h3]
This game mode will consist on a variety of challenges in three different categories. Each challenge will have its own Steam Leaderboard, which will allow you to compete for the highest score.
Here you have a preview of each challenge icon if you want to guess.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442965/0a81b97cb67bf233ab5d0e8592e9b9e5aa76e2af.png[/img]

[h3]Custom food[/h3]
Similarly to how custom characters can be used in the game, you will soon be able to use any ".png" image as food. You will be able to share them through the Steam Workshop so that anyone can use and enjoy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442965/bb596dc4560710f7b33c9a6fbca5466439c40ad7.png[/img]

When the update finally drops the game will go from free-to-play to costing 1$ as I feel confident with the final product. You can still grab it for free and keep it forever until the update launches. For all of you that already have the game on your libraries it will remain there with no cost.

That's all for now, stay safe, and thanks for everything.
